testing_and_attributes.requirement: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs, dropdowns, table rows) must contain role-based data-testid attributes in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the top persistent simulation banner is always mounted at the top of the viewport (fixed position with z-50).
Add top padding (pt-12) to the main container so content doesn't get covered by the fixed simulation banner.
Utilize JetBrains Mono or monospace font styling for all ETH hashes, wallet addresses, block numbers, transaction IDs, and currency amounts.
Implement the 19-step workflow stepper with interactive stage details and simulation state actions.
Provide clear role switcher (Sender, Recipient, Administrator) with contextual capability toggles.
Integrate PDF report export modal with a prominent 'SIMULATION' watermark overlay.
Include a full reset button in Settings to return the VB-ETH-2026-001 simulation to default state.
